text:
mira: proposing a small wire-contract change for audit events. goal: add a handful of optional bits, retire one old session id, and ship a lightweight validator so customers can test before we flip any switches. want alignment on numbering, migration, and comms.
kevin: ok. can you enumerate exact keys and what gets removed?
mira: new optional keys: `contract_id` (int), `request_id` (uuid), `client_context` (map: ip, ua, device_id), `kms_key_ref` (short string), `rbac_delta` (array of change objects). key to deprecate: `legacy_sid` (we standardized on request_id elsewhere).
jorge: I prefer a numeric contract id emitted at top-level rather than a string tag. easier for runtime switches.
mira: agreed. we'll use `contract_id: 3` for the new contract. readers should switch on that int and fall back when absent.
nana: customer ops note: many customers validate strictly. we must run an opt-in beta and give validation tooling + sample payloads.
kevin: ops details: make new keys optional for at least 60 days. add telemetry that counts presence/absence per key so we can measure adoption before any removal.
lina: about KMS: `kms_key_ref` must never contain any secret material. only store an identifier format like `rn:kms:region:key:xxxx`. document rotation behavior and masking rules.
jorge: RBAC note: `rbac_delta` can expose role names or resource paths. default behavior should redact sensitive strings unless the tenant config opts into verbose deltas.
mira: rollout plan suggested:
- stage A (dev/stage): serializers accept contract 2 & 3; producers emit `contract_id` when available; add presence telemetry.
- stage B (internal canary): route 2% prod traffic from internal orgs for 7 days.
- stage C (customer opt-in): invite up to 10 customers to enable contract=3 outputs and use the hosted validator.
- stage D (ramp): 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 weeks with rollback gates.
kevin: historical logs: do we rewrite immutable storage?
mira: no rewriting by default. instead:
- keep old records as `contract_id: 2`.
- provide a read-time adapter in Console & SDKs that can normalize v2->v3 view where possible.
- offer an opt-in backfill tool for customers who want their own copies rewritten.
nana: validator tooling: customers want both local CLI and hosted dry-run. propose `contract-checker` CLI and a Console POST /audit/validate that returns a compatibility report and diffs.
lina: security: validate the hosted endpoint for rate limits, auth, and avoid logging sensitive sample payloads. run a threat model before GA.
kevin: test matrix:
- unit serializers/deserializers for both contracts
- e2e: replay v2 through new pipeline, ensure no crashes
- resilience: entirely drop `client_context` and confirm graceful handling
- consumer integration test with a downstream parser that expects v2
mira: telemetry & alerts to build:
- pct events with `contract_id` present
- per-field presence counters for each new key
- downstream consumer error count tied to audit ingestion
- alert if <90% of events include `contract_id` after 7 days post-GA
jorge: governance: add entry to compliance registry. deprecation window for `legacy_sid` = 90 days after GA. require security review for validator tooling.
kevin: API behavior: `/audit/events` responses should include `contract_id` and provide both legacy and new-friendly top-level fields where possible. clients should inspect `contract_id` first.
mira: sample minimal contract=3 payload (not exhaustive):
```
{ "contract_id": 3, "ts": "2026-05-03T14:22:00Z", "request_id": "b2f3...", "actor": {"id":"u321"}, "client_context": {"ip":"4.5.6.7"}, "action":"rbac.change", "rbac_delta": [{"resource":"/models/9","from":"read","to":"write"}], "kms_key_ref":"rn:kms:us-east-1:key:abcd", "meta": {...} }
```
mira: deliverables:
- serializer/flagging in producers (owner: kevin)
- read-time adapter + SDK helpers (owner: devex)
- `contract-checker` CLI + hosted validator (owner: lina/devex)
- telemetry dashboards and alerts (owner: jorge)
- customer comms: beta signup + migration docs (owner: nana)
kevin: roll cutoff/prereqs before GA: feature flag, telemetry dashboards, validator running, backward-compat tests, support runbook.
nana: comms plan: beta email, Console banner, migration FAQ, SDK bump notes. include examples for common CI failures and how to run `contract-checker`.
mira: risks and mitigations:
- strict downstream parsers break -> mitigation: long optional window, validator, and sample fixtures
- event size increase -> mitigation: optional fields and guidance on cost
- accidental PII exposure -> mitigation: default redaction + security review
deploy-bot: deploy started: audit-contract/contract-3-support -> staging (canary=2%) :rocket:
mira: next steps: I'll open the design PR with this checklist and the serializer patch. please review and tag security & compliance reviewers. pinging @kevin @jorge @nana @lina for visibility. :eyes:
